status: Workflow now has a bounded native approval oversight read: the Company/Holding open-approval queue and one record's approval route, decision history and linked command receipt/audit/outbox evidence. The owner-local HTTP router, strict Next transport and workflow-owned approval-administration SSR cutover are present. Workflow remains foundation overall: approval decision/reroute commands, command-ledger HTTP execution, a mounted shared-composition backend and authenticated browser acceptance remain open.

scope.workflowBoundary: The qualified slice is the approval-administration queue read used by the approval issues/history pages and the native evidence card for one selected approval record. It returns Workflow-owned approval instances, steps and decisions plus the command receipts, audit events and outbox events linked by those decisions' command ids. Approval decisions, reroute/cancel/revise commands, staff-task/expense/leave owners' record mutations, policy-derived blocked reasons, notice delivery and every other Workflow surface remain retained TypeScript.
scope.domain: Portable approval oversight policy in `packages/server-workflow/src/domain/approval_oversight.rs`: exact Company and Holding-wide scope, `organization.manage`, bounded non-legal approval kinds (`expense`, `leave`, `leave_cancellation`, `task`, `overtime`), 50-row open queue, 64 steps, 512 decisions, 512 receipts, 1024 audit rows, 512 outbox rows, 64 KiB JSON/text fields, 2,000-byte reasons, exact state/phase/authority/action sets, blocked-reason coherence, timestamp/version/counter bounds, ordered and unique row identities, linked-command enforcement for receipts/audit/outbox and tag-free identifier checks.
scope.application: `packages/server-workflow/src/application/approval_oversight.rs` authorizes the actor before any repository call, keeps the repository Company, returns the queue with the evaluated time, reads one evidence record and revalidates every persisted row before presentation. It opens no transaction, resolves no session, reads no HTTP request and never falls back to a retained reader.
scope.adapters: `packages/server-workflow/src/adapters/approval_oversight_postgres.rs` reads only `approval_instances`, `approval_steps`, `approval_decisions`, `command_receipts`, `audit_events` and `outbox_events`. It requires the caller's serializable Holding transaction, locks those six tables in SHARE mode, keeps the exact Company predicate, reads the latest instance by insertion order, bounds every collection in SQL and rejects oversized persisted fields before transfer. No business-record, Identity, People or Organization SQL is added.
scope.http: `packages/server-workflow/src/adapters/approval_oversight_http.rs` exposes `GET /api/v1/holdings/{holding_slug}/workflow/approvals` and `GET /api/v1/holdings/{holding_slug}/workflow/approvals/{kind}/{record_id}/evidence`. It requires exact registered Host/Holding targets and HTTPS origins, rejects duplicate/invalid targets, foreign Origins, unknown kinds, malformed/oversized record ids, query strings and request bodies, returns private/no-store plus no-referrer/nosniff responses and maps BusinessError to 401/403/404/409/422/503. Session, Company scope, current authority and the serializable unit stay behind `ApprovalOversightHttpBackend`.
scope.transport: `packages/server-workflow/src/public/native-workflow-evidence.ts` validates `ERPX_NATIVE_WORKFLOW_CONFIG`: literal loopback private base, reserved ports 3000/3001/3100/3101/3103/5432/5433/5435/8080 and owned app ports 3200-3299 excluded, exact unique HTTPS Holding origins, unique Hosts/slugs/ids, 250..30000 ms timeout, bounded cookie/Host/context headers, exact queue/evidence/context field sets, Company/kind/record coherence, unique ordered rows, decision-command linkage, 50/64/512/1024/512 collection bounds and a 2 MiB response bound. A configured failure never falls back to the retained queue.
scope.ssr: In `packages/server-workflow/src/adapters/approval-administration.ts`, a configured native queue replaces the retained approval_instances queue read for the approval issues/history list; a selected record additionally fetches its native evidence and renders the owner-issued route, decisions and receipt/audit/outbox counts in `packages/feature-workflow/src/components/approval-administration.tsx`. Retained staff settings, record-version reads and the policy-rich per-row approval view remain in the same page. Without `ERPX_NATIVE_WORKFLOW_CONFIG` the retained queue is used and no native evidence card is requested. A configured malformed/failed native read throws the existing ApiError surface and never silently reads the retained queue or fabricates empty evidence.
scope.notClaimed: No approval approve/reject/reroute/cancel/revise command, no staff-task/expense/leave record mutation, no command-ledger execution HTTP, no policy-derived native blocked reason, no names resolution, no shared composition mount, no Next API route, no browser/authenticated SSR render, no staging, private production or Cloudflare verification and no whole-workflow/owner completion flag.
